title: Rockstar Suggests Disney World and SeaWorld Won't Be in GTA 6
description: According to IGN Games, Rockstar has suggested that GTA 6 probably won't feature key Florida attractions like Disney World and SeaWorld. Read more for details.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Hints at the Absence of Major Florida Attractions in GTA 6

As anticipation continues to build for the eventual release of *Grand Theft Auto 6*, players and industry analysts are constantly speculating about the scale, scope, and specific landmarks that will populate the fictional state of Leonida. Recently, according to a report by gaming media outlet IGN Games, Rockstar has suggested that GTA 6 will likely not feature some of Florida's most iconic and key attractions, such as Disney World and SeaWorld.

### Navigating Real-World Landmarks and Satire

The *Grand Theft Auto* franchise has always built its reputation on a heavy dose of satire, poking fun at American culture, politics, and geography. With Vice City and the broader state of Leonida serving as the setting for the upcoming title, fans have naturally wondered how Rockstar would adapt Florida's massive tourism industry, particularly its world-famous theme parks.

However, based on the recent suggestion highlighted by IGN Games, massive commercial entertainment complexes like Disney World and SeaWorld probably won't find their way into the game. Licensing complexities, corporate brand protection, and the sheer scale of these attractions make direct inclusion difficult. More importantly, Rockstar has historically favored creating its own fictional, heavily satirized parodies rather than replicating real-world properties item-for-item.

### What This Means for the Open World

While the exclusion of these specific real-world parks might disappoint some fans looking for a virtual vacation, it opens the door for Rockstar's signature creative humor. Analysts note that the developer will likely introduce original, fictional theme parks or entertainment resorts that capture the eccentric vibe of Florida tourism without stepping on actual corporate toes. This approach preserves the satirical edge that defines the franchise.

### Editor's Take

While missing out on a digital version of Disney World or SeaWorld might feel like a missed opportunity for virtual tourism, it is ultimately a smart creative boundary. Rockstar thrives on originality and biting satire; inventing their own over-the-top Florida attractions will give players much more room for chaotic fun than an authentic recreation ever could.
